Using Fermat’s little theorem, \(96^{162} \equiv 1 \pmod{163}\), so  
\[
96^{593} \equiv 96^{107} \pmod{163}.
\]

Repeated squaring:
\[
96^2 \equiv 88,\quad 96^4 \equiv 83,\quad 96^8 \equiv 43,\quad 96^{16} \equiv 56,\quad 96^{32} \equiv 39,\quad 96^{64} \equiv 54.
\]

Since \(107 = 64+32+8+2+1\):
\[
96^{107} \equiv 54 \cdot 39 \cdot 43 \cdot 88 \cdot 96 \equiv 4 \pmod{163}.
\]

FINAL: 4
